Header: Fusarium oxysporum pv. musacearum Kabore in Kinyarwanda

Prevention: Use virgin land (no banana for at least 20 years)
Do not plant susceptible varieties like
Avoid movement of animals in plantations
Control movement of water across plantations through soil erosion control
Monitoring: Follow-up and monitor banana plantations regularly, particularly plantations of susceptible banana varieties
Progressive yellowing of leaves from older to younger leaves until only a few of the youngest leaves remain green and erect with the older ones forming a ‘skirt’ around the stem.
Eventually, all the leaves will collapse.
A brownish ring on cut stems.
Action can be taken once 1st infected plant is observed
Direct Control: After removing infected banana plantations, rotate with other food crops such as maize, beans
Uproot and destroy infected banana mat
Restrictions: The use of chemicals is not recommended for the management of fusarium wilt of banana
